name: legal-terminus-mobile
description: Capacitor Android and iOS shell around the Portal (Portal/dist-mobile).

scripts.build:web: node scripts/app-env.mjs && cd ../Portal && npm run build:mobile && cd ../MobileApp && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:android && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:ios && cap run ios
